description: Committed script (scripts/dump_c.exs or similar): dump the generated C of every test kernel and example, diff byte-identical before/after a change. Chosen over a baseline-committing ExUnit test (baselines would churn with every intentional codegen change) and over throwaway scripts (the Facts extraction, the ADR-0007 migration steps, Defk.Copies and the strip record all need it). Decided: /improve-codebase-architecture grilling 2026-10-12.
title: Dump-all-C script: byte-identical gate for compiler refactors
